metadata.description: Claude Code plugins for auditing and maintaining research codebases, and for building more skills like them.

plugins.name: technical-debt
plugins.description: Read-only, multi-agent audit of any git repo for abandoned code, parameters, config keys, notebook cells and files. Writes a register with DELETE / KEEP / DECIDE recommendations and a blank Decision column; never edits code.

plugins.name: create-claude-skill
plugins.description: Create, update and publish Claude Code skills end to end: write a portable skill, package it in your plugin marketplace, lint and validate it, test-install it, link it for local use, and push only after you say yes.

plugins.name: idea-to-market
plugins.description: Evaluate an idea with four due-diligence checks and a one-page decision memo, then plan commercialization (MVP, customer validation, go-to-market, operational readiness) only after the team approves. Two skills share one versioned handoff: /idea-due-diligence and /idea-commercialization.

plugins.name: learning-strategy
plugins.description: Tutors you through learning any topic with ten study strategies (ELI5, 80/20, mind map, schematic, first principles, Socratic questioning, Feynman technique, visual study guide, quiz me, sticky notes), one at a time or as a ten-step sequence that ends in spaced review. Asks one question at a time and saves notes only in learning/<topic>/ after you say yes.

plugins.name: research-plots
plugins.description: House style for every data figure: white background, black text, thick black frame and lines, large fonts, a few colour-blind-safe Okabe-Ito colours that keep one meaning across a project, labels next to the data instead of legends, real data only, and PDF plus 600 dpi PNG at final print size. Ships a matplotlib style module and a checker for finished figures. Use when making, restyling, fixing or reviewing any plot, chart or figure, in matplotlib, pgfplots, plotly or PowerPoint, for a paper, slides, a poster or a report.
